cards.headline: OCT to Assess Risk of Progression of Multiple Sclerosis

source.title: OCT to Assess Risk of Progression of Multiple Sclerosis: A Report by the American Academy of Ophthalmology.
source.excerpt: Evidence supports the development of OCT-derived pRNFL and macular GC-IPL thickness measurements as biomarkers for future progression of MS in patients with MS or MS precursor syndromes.

cards.headline: Effect of Resident Involvement in Ophthalmic Surgery on Patient Outcomes

source.title: Effect of Resident Involvement in Ophthalmic Surgery on Patient Outcomes: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis.
source.excerpt: Resident-led surgeries appear overall safe, effective, and comparable to attending-led surgeries with respect to commonly encountered perioperative complications. Specific differences in outcomes exhibit significant heterogeneity and small sample sizes, and may be of unclear or equivocal clinical significance.

cards.headline: Bilateral simultaneous postoperative endophthalmitis

source.title: Bilateral simultaneous postoperative endophthalmitis: review of cases reported over the past 50 years.
source.publisher: Journal of cataract and refractive surgery
source.excerpt: Strict adherence to the i SBCS General Principles of Excellence in ISBCS 2009 surgical protocol and care with operating room construction seem to considerably lessen the risk.

cards.headline: FLACS vs phacoemulsification in shallow anterior chambers

source.title: FLACS vs phacoemulsification in shallow anterior chambers: systematic review and meta-analysis.
source.publisher: Journal of cataract and refractive surgery
source.excerpt: FLACS was associated with fewer early postoperative complications, supported by moderate-certainty evidence, and with lower ECL and ultrasound energy, although the magnitude of these benefits remains uncertain on low-certainty evidence.

cards.headline: Prevalence of Intravitreal Silicone Oil Following Intravitreal Injections: A Meta-Analysis

source.title: Prevalence of Intravitreal Silicone Oil Following Intravitreal Injections: A Meta-Analysis.
source.excerpt: IVIs are frequently associated with intravitreal SiO and floaters. Siliconized syringes and staked-in needles may increase contamination risk. Utilizing SiO-free syringes and attachable needles may reduce SiO-related complications. Randomized controlled trials should confirm these preventive strategies.

cards.headline: Artificial intelligence in diabetic retinopathy

source.title: Artificial intelligence in diabetic retinopathy: From deep learning to foundation models, clinical translation, and real-world deployment.
source.excerpt: Particular emphasis is placed on the translational readiness of foundation models, multimodal retinal intelligence, and emerging technologies for large-scale screening, therapeutic decision-making, and longitudinal disease monitoring.

cards.headline: Deep Learning and Domain Expertise for Fabricating High-Performance Biosensors

source.title: Deep Learning and Domain Expertise for Fabricating High-Performance Biosensors.
source.excerpt: Our work extends the previously published DeepSEED framework into a powerful pipeline for biosensor optimization and delivers a portfolio of high-performance regulatory elements, addressing a critical need and facilitating the development of more intelligent and productive metabolic engineering systems.

cards.headline: Cer

source.title: Cer
source.excerpt: Cer ist ein chemisches Element mit dem Elementsymbol Ce und der Ordnungszahl 58. Im Periodensystem steht es in der Gruppe der Lanthanoide und zählt damit auch zu den Metallen der Seltenen Erden.

cards.headline: Secondary outcomes of lens and cataract surgery

source.title: Secondary outcomes of lens and cataract surgery: More than just "best-corrected visual acuity".
source.publisher: Progress in retinal and eye research
source.excerpt: We believe that these aspects will become more and more relevant when considering new IOL designs and surgical techniques, a fact that will benefit both the patients and the surgeons.

cards.headline: Chlorhexidine and other alternatives for povidone-iodine in ophthalmic surgery

source.title: Chlorhexidine and other alternatives for povidone-iodine in ophthalmic surgery: review of comparative studies.
source.publisher: Journal of cataract and refractive surgery
source.excerpt: Disinfectant solutions other than PVI or chlorhexidine will require further investigations to show their utility in ocular surgery.

cards.headline: Renal Impairment and Age-Related Macular Degeneration

source.title: Renal Impairment and Age-Related Macular Degeneration: A Comprehensive Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
source.excerpt: Renal impairment, particularly reduced eGFR (<60 mL/min/1.73 m²), elevated serum creatinine, and dialysis exposure, was associated with modestly higher odds of AMD, and the association was most consistent for nonexudative disease.

cards.headline: Application of interpretable deep learning in brain age prediction: a comprehensive review

source.title: Application of interpretable deep learning in brain age prediction: a comprehensive review.
source.excerpt: However, interpretation remains sensitive to methodological and imaging-related factors, while brain age gap (BAG) is also influenced by age dependency, calibration, reference-population composition, and site heterogeneity.

cards.headline: The use of artificial intelligence (AI) in neuropsychiatric drug discovery

source.title: The use of artificial intelligence (AI) in neuropsychiatric drug discovery: current challenges and future directions.
source.excerpt: Using AI-based technologies such as AlphaFold, future pharmacological targets will be identified based on gene expression data, and large libraries of chemical compounds will be screened rapidly to identify novel drug candidates, resulting in shorter pre-clinical phase with lower costs.

cards.headline: NASA

source.title: NASA
source.excerpt: Die NASA ist die 1958 gegründete zivile US-Bundesbehörde für Raumfahrt und Flugwissenschaft. Der Hauptsitz befindet sich in Washington, D.C. Zugleich ist die NASA eine wichtige geowissenschaftliche Forschungsinstitution und stellt in den USA die meisten Forschungsgelder für klimawissenschaftliche Forschungsarbeiten bereit.

cards.headline: The Use of Free Weight Squats in Sports

source.title: The Use of Free Weight Squats in Sports: A Narrative Review-Squatting Movements, Adaptation, and Sports Performance: Physiological.
source.publisher: Journal of strength and conditioning research
source.excerpt: Therefore, the training intensity and volume used for the squat and its variations should progressively become greater while adhering to the concept of periodization and recognized training principles.

cards.headline: The Role of Strength on Punch Impact Force in Boxing

source.title: The Role of Strength on Punch Impact Force in Boxing.
source.publisher: Journal of strength and conditioning research
source.excerpt: Future experimental studies are needed to infer causality regarding the role that strength training has on punch impact force in both elite amateur and professional boxers.

cards.headline: Effects of sodium bicarbonate supplementation on exercise performance: an umbrella review

source.title: Effects of sodium bicarbonate supplementation on exercise performance: an umbrella review.
source.publisher: Journal of the International Society of Sports Nutrition
source.excerpt: Based on meta-analyses of moderate to high quality, it can be concluded that sodium bicarbonate supplementation acutely enhances peak anaerobic power, anaerobic capacity, performance in endurance events lasting ∼45 s to 8 min, muscle endurance, 2000-m rowing performance, and high-intensity intermittent running.

cards.headline: Wer Allah und Seinen Engeln und Seinen Gesandten und Gibril und Mikal feind ist …

source.title: Sure Al-Baqarah, 2:98
source.excerpt: من عادى الله وملائكته، ورسله من الملائكة أو البشر، وبخاصة المَلَكان جبريلُ وميكالُ؛ لأن اليهود زعموا أن جبريل عدوهم، وميكال وليُّهم، فأعلمهم الله أنه من عادى واحدًا منهما فقد عادى الآخر، وعادى الله أيضًا، فإن الله عدو للجاحدين ما أنزل على رسوله محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم.

cards.arabic: مَن كَانَ عَدُوًّا لِّلَّهِ وَمَلَـٰٓئِكَتِهِۦ وَرُسُلِهِۦ وَجِبْرِيلَ وَمِيكَىٰلَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَدُوٌّ لِّلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
cards.translation: Wer Allah und Seinen Engeln und Seinen Gesandten und Gibril und Mikal feind ist, so ist Allah den Ungläubigen feind.
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?

cards.headline: Und Wir haben zu dir ja (im Qur’an) klare Zeichen hinabgesandt.

source.title: Sure Al-Baqarah, 2:99
source.excerpt: ولقد أنزلنا إليك -أيها الرسول- آيات بينات واضحات تدل على أنّك رسول من الله صدقا وحقا، وما ينكر تلك الآيات إلا الخارجون عن دين الله.

cards.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ءَايَـٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَـٰتٍ ۖ وَمَا يَكْفُرُ بِهَآ إِلَّا ٱلْفَـٰسِقُونَ
cards.translation: Und Wir haben zu dir ja (im Qur’an) klare Zeichen hinabgesandt. Doch nur die Frevler verleugnen sie.
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?
cards.body: Proofs of Muhammad's ﷺ Prophethood: Imam Abu Ja`far bin Jarir said that Allah's statement, وَلَقَدْ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ءَايَـتٍ بَيِّنَـتٍ (And indeed We have sent down to you manifest Ayat) means, "We have sent to you, O Muhammad, clear signs that testify to your prophethood."

cards.headline: Epidemiology of Cataract-Related Blindness in Brazil

source.title: Epidemiology of Cataract-Related Blindness in Brazil: 30 Years of Public Policy Evolution: A Review Article.
source.excerpt: The increase in surgeries was driven by unlimited federal funding, private contracts, and targeted parliamentary amendments. Despite these efforts, regional disparities persist, requiring equitable policies based on local epidemiologic data. Ensuring access to cataract surgery demands sustained public investment.

cards.headline: Defocus curves: focusing on factors influencing assessment

source.title: Defocus curves: focusing on factors influencing assessment.
source.publisher: Journal of cataract and refractive surgery
source.excerpt: A good understanding of these factors and standardization of the methodology are important to ensure optimal cross-study comparisons.

cards.headline: Diagnostic Accuracy of IDX-DR for Detecting Diabetic Retinopathy

source.title: Diagnostic Accuracy of IDX-DR for Detecting Diabetic Retinopathy: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
source.excerpt: IDX-DR is a highly effective diagnostic tool for diabetic retinopathy screening, with robust sensitivity and good specificity. Its integration into clinical practice, especially in resource-limited settings, can potentially improve early detection and reduce vision loss.

cards.headline: Exergaming Interventions for Preventing Falls and Injurious Falls in Older People

source.title: Exergaming Interventions for Preventing Falls and Injurious Falls in Older People: Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials.
source.excerpt: Low- to moderate-certainty evidence suggests that exergames may reduce fall rates, particularly in comparisons with active intervention control groups, and may reduce the number of fallers compared with usual care.

cards.headline: Hematopoietic stem cell aging

source.title: Hematopoietic stem cell aging: a review of transcriptional and multi-omics insights and potential paths for AI integration.
source.excerpt: We propose a curated, centralized, interactive database as a community resource to integrate these layers, enabling meta-analyses, artificial intelligence-driven discoveries, and accelerated therapeutic interventions for age-related hematopoietic disorders.

cards.headline: Schleswig-Holstein

source.title: Schleswig-Holstein
source.excerpt: Schleswig-Holstein ist eine parlamentarische Republik und ein teilsouveräner Gliedstaat (Land) der Bundesrepublik Deutschland. Die Landeshauptstadt und bevölkerungsreichste Stadt des Landes ist die Großstadt Kiel; weitere Oberzentren sind die Großstadt Lübeck sowie die Mittelstädte Flensburg und Neumünster.

cards.headline: Pediatric Cataract Surgery Following Treatment for Retinoblastoma

source.title: Pediatric Cataract Surgery Following Treatment for Retinoblastoma: A Case Series and Systematic Review.
source.excerpt: Modern retinoblastoma therapies, including intravitreal chemotherapy and vitrectomy, cause secondary cataract. Following cataract surgery, intraocular recurrence risk is low and extraocular spread is rare. Although surgery improves tumor visualization, visual prognosis may be limited by several factors. Challenges include biometry limitations and a high incidence of zonulopathy.

cards.headline: Eplerenone and Spironolactone for Chronic Central Serous Chorioretinopathy

source.title: Eplerenone and Spironolactone for Chronic Central Serous Chorioretinopathy: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
source.excerpt: MRAs offer short-term benefits in reducing SRF but may have limited long-term durability based on current evidence, highlighting the need for further studies.

cards.headline: Psoriasis, Cardiovascular Risk, and Artificial Intelligence

source.title: Psoriasis, Cardiovascular Risk, and Artificial Intelligence: Precision Risk Stratification Along the Skin-Vascular Axis-A Narrative Review.
source.excerpt: Ultimately, we propose that AI-augmented tools should complement clinical judgment within an interdisciplinary framework to precisely stratify risk and potentially guide interventions to improve cardiovascular outcomes in psoriasis.

cards.headline: Conditional superiorities and unaddressed bottlenecks

source.title: Conditional superiorities and unaddressed bottlenecks: a critical review of artificial intelligence for waterborne microbial detection.
source.excerpt: KEY POINTS: • AI shows favorable performance for microbial detection under lab conditions. • Model performance declines greatly in complex water with many practical barriers. • Standardized data and validation will advance real-world application.

cards.headline: Intracameral phenylephrine for surgical mydriasis and intraoperative floppy-iris syndrome

source.title: Intracameral phenylephrine for surgical mydriasis and intraoperative floppy-iris syndrome: systemic adverse effects and optimal dose.
source.publisher: Journal of cataract and refractive surgery
source.excerpt: For management of intraoperative floppy-iris syndrome, 0.31% may be effective, though a higher concentration (1% to 1.25%) may be required.

cards.headline: Risk factors for nosocomial infections in ECMO patients

source.title: Risk factors for nosocomial infections in ECMO patients: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
source.excerpt: NSI in ECMO patients arises from an interplay of baseline characteristics, illness severity, and invasive support duration/intensity. A stratified, risk-factor-based prevention strategy is warranted. Given the predominantly retrospective evidence, prospective studies are required for validation.

cards.headline: Artificial intelligence in assisted localization of fetal ultrasound standard planes

source.title: Artificial intelligence in assisted localization of fetal ultrasound standard planes: a narrative review.
source.publisher: Quantitative imaging in medicine and surgery
source.excerpt: AI significantly advances ultrasound by automating standard plane localization, particularly in fetal ultrasound, enhancing diagnostic consistency and workflow efficiency. Integration into clinical practice promises to reduce operator dependency and improve screening accessibility. Persistent challenges include model generalizability, data scarcity, and real-world clinical integration.

cards.headline: Ocular injectable treatment options for postcataract macular edema: systematic review

source.title: Ocular injectable treatment options for postcataract macular edema: systematic review.
source.publisher: Journal of cataract and refractive surgery
source.excerpt: Although the growing body of real-world data favors improvements in visual acuity and anatomical outcomes with these injectable treatments, larger studies with a better study design are needed to demonstrate their role in the management of PCME.

cards.headline: Ist es nicht (so), daß jedesmal, wenn sie eine Verpflichtung eingingen …

source.title: Sure Al-Baqarah, 2:100
source.excerpt: ما أقبح حال بني إسرائيل في نقضهم للعهود!! فكلما عاهدوا عهدًا طرح ذلك العهد فريق منهم، ونقضوه، فتراهم يُبْرِمون العهد اليوم وينقضونه غدًا، بل أكثرهم لا يصدِّقون بما جاء به نبي الله ورسوله محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم.

cards.arabic: أَوَكُلَّمَا عَـٰهَدُوا۟ عَهْدًا نَّبَذَهُۥ فَرِيقٌ مِّنْهُم ۚ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
cards.translation: Ist es nicht (so), daß jedesmal, wenn sie eine Verpflichtung eingingen, sie eine Gruppe von ihnen verworfen hat? - Nein! Vielmehr glauben die meisten von ihnen (doch) nicht.
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?
cards.body: Proofs of Muhammad's ﷺ Prophethood: Imam Abu Ja`far bin Jarir said that Allah's statement, وَلَقَدْ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ءَايَـتٍ بَيِّنَـتٍ (And indeed We have sent down to you manifest Ayat) means, "We have sent to you, O Muhammad, clear signs that testify to your prophethood."

cards.headline: Und als (nun) zu ihnen ein Gesandter von Allah gekommen ist, das bestätigend …

source.title: Sure Al-Baqarah, 2:101
source.excerpt: ولما جاءهم محمد رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم بالقرآن الموافق لما معهم من التوراة طرح فريق منهم كتاب الله، وجعلوه وراء ظهورهم، شأنهم شأن الجهال الذين لا يعلمون حقيقته.

cards.arabic: وَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ مِّنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ مُصَدِّقٌ لِّمَا مَعَهُمْ نَبَذَ فَرِيقٌ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ كِتَـٰبَ ٱللَّهِ وَرَآءَ ظُهُورِهِمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
cards.translation: Und als (nun) zu ihnen ein Gesandter von Allah gekommen ist, das bestätigend, was ihnen (an Offenbarungen) bereits vorlag, da hat eine Gruppe von denjenigen, denen die Schrift gegeben wurde, das Buch Allahs hinter ihren Rücken geworfen, als ob sie nicht Bescheid wüßten.
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?
cards.body: Proofs of Muhammad's ﷺ Prophethood: Imam Abu Ja`far bin Jarir said that Allah's statement, وَلَقَدْ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ءَايَـتٍ بَيِّنَـتٍ (And indeed We have sent down to you manifest Ayat) means, "We have sent to you, O Muhammad, clear signs that testify to your prophethood."
